verdict.rationale: Supermemory automatically extracts facts, builds a living knowledge graph and maintains auto-updating user profiles from ingested data, which counts as AI-generated insight generation, and it can surface related-memory context via graph traversal (docs-14, docs-15, docs-27, gh-4). However there is no evidence of proactive 'suggestions' (e.g., recommended actions, surfaced anomalies, or generated recommendations) — it's framed purely as context/retrieval infrastructure rather than an insights/suggestions UI. Missing for 10: proactive suggestion generation, an insights dashboard/report feature, and independent evidence of insight quality beyond docs.
